productionSalesSpeedBonus.name: Production / Sales Speed Bonus
productionSalesSpeedBonus.description: A persistent bonus system where points can be allocated between production speed and sales speed. Earned every 5 company levels.
productionSalesSpeedBonus.acquisition: Earned every 5th company level (level 5, 10, 15, 20, ... up to level 60)
productionSalesSpeedBonus.maxBase: 3% per 5 levels. e.g. at level 15: +9% total bonus points to distribute

productionModifier.name: Production Speed Bonus
productionModifier.description: Increases production speed. Reduces production time.
productionModifier.range: Slider position. Minimum -3%. Maximum = initial bonus + 3% (from sales side).
productionModifier.effect: Each +1% reduces production time by ~1% (applied as multiplier: 1 / (1 - modifier/100))

salesModifier.name: Sales Speed Bonus
salesModifier.description: Increases sales speed. More units sold per hour.
salesModifier.range: Slider position. Minimum -3%. Maximum = initial bonus + 3% (from production side).

mechanics.totalRange: Total productionModifier + salesModifier = fixed pool. The sum is constant; slider transfers points between them.

realign.description: Move points between production and sales speed bonus using the slider in Headquarters > SimBoosts.
realign.note: Cost was halved from 150/200 to 75/100 in a 2024 update.

payload.production: integer (negative = move to production, positive = move to sales)

resourceProductionModifiers.name: Resource Production Modifiers (Events)
resourceProductionModifiers.description: Temporary buffs or debuffs affecting production speed of specific resources. Also known as 'market events' or 'production events'.
resourceProductionModifiers.source: Server-driven events fetched from API. Shown on Encyclopedia > Events page.

dataStructure.since: ISO datetime when the modifier starts
dataStructure.until: ISO datetime when the modifier ends

resourceProductionModifiers.duration: Variable — defined by server. Events have a 'since' and 'until' date. Typically days to weeks.

stacking.rule: ONE modifier per resource at a time. A new event for the same resource replaces the existing one.
stacking.description: The system finds the modifier whose time range contains the current time. There is at most one active modifier per resource kind.

formula.description: speedModifier is applied as a multiplier: e.g. +50% speedModifier means 1.5x base production. -30% means 0.7x base production.

resourceProductionModifiers.limits: No cooldowns. Events are server-scheduled and apply automatically. Players cannot control them.

recreationBonus.name: Recreation Bonus
recreationBonus.description: Additional production and sales speed bonus from active recreation buildings.
recreationBonus.calculation: Sum of sizes (levels) of all recreation buildings that are currently being upkept (busy with upkeep).
recreationBonus.formula: recreationBonus = sum of size for each recreation building where: building.category === RECREATION && building.busy && building.busy.upkeep && !building.position.startsWith('Fp') (not in reposition queue)

effect.production: Added to productionModifier: effectiveProductionModifier = productionModifier + recreationBonus
effect.sales: Added to salesModifier: effectiveSalesModifier = salesModifier + recreationBonus
effect.executiveSalaryImpact: The combined (salesModifier + recreationBonus) affects executive salary cost: costPerPercent = |salesModifier + recreationBonus| * 0.02

upkeep.description: Recreation buildings can be set to auto-upkeep. Each upkeep order costs SimBoosts.
upkeep.note: gO = [15, 25, 40] — costs for 1st, 2nd, 3rd recreation building upkeep order respectively.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.description: A speed multiplier applied to all production and sales operations, based on company level.

formula.description: Acceleration divides the final production/sales time. e.g. acceleration 2.0 means everything runs 2x faster.

acceleration.note: This is NOT a SimBoost feature but part of the overall game speed system. Included for completeness.

completeProductionFormula.description: Full production time calculation combining all modifiers

steps.name: Base hourly rate
steps.source: Resource base rate × event modifier × economy salary modifier

steps.name: Production time (hours)
steps.source: Required quantity divided by units per hour

steps.name: Apply production speed bonus
steps.source: Reduce time by production bonus percentage

steps.name: Apply acceleration
steps.source: Speed up by level-based acceleration multiplier

completeSalesFormula.description: Sales speed calculation combining all modifiers

steps.name: Base units sold per hour
steps.source: Market demand based on economy state and resource

steps.name: Apply sales speed bonus
steps.source: Increase sales rate by combined sales bonus and CMO executive skill
